metadata.title: Kuril Islands Militarization Monitor — Areas of Interest
metadata.description: Seed list of monitored military facilities on the southern Kuril chain (including the islands Japan claims as the Northern Territories). Coordinates are approximate and should be verified and refined. This is the single editable config for areas of interest; add new sites here without touching code.

properties.name: Burevestnik / Yasny Airbase
properties.name_ja: ブレヴェスニク（ヤースヌィ）航空基地
properties.notes: Military airfield on Iturup. Approximate location; verify and refine polygon.
